title: tragacantha oreades
intro: Tragacantha oreades, commonly known as Oat Tops or Mountain Oat, is a type of flowering plant in the grass family (Poaceae). This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including its ability to soothe digestive issues and reduce inflammation. The therapeutic actions of Tragacantha oreades include its use as a demulcent, protecting the mucous membranes and promoting healing, as well as its anti-inflammatory properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include a variety of compounds such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its therapeutic effects.
